title: Introduction to R
desc: A foundation in R: installation, data types, functions, and reading and writing data.
abstract: The starting point for everything. Covers R installation, RStudio setup, core data types (vectors, lists, data frames), basic functions, and reading/writing CSV and other file formats.

title: Data Manipulation in R
desc: From data creation to wrangling: tidyverse pipelines, wide/long pivots and the Palmer Penguins dataset.
abstract: Covers the full tidyverse data manipulation pipeline: filtering, mutating, grouping, summarising, and reshaping data between wide and long formats using the Palmer Penguins dataset.

title: Data Visualisation in R
desc: Base R plots to publication-quality facetted ggplots — the complete visualisation toolkit.
abstract: A thorough introduction to data visualisation in R, from quick base plots to layered, publication-ready ggplot2 figures with custom themes, scales, and facets.

title: Spatial Data in R
desc: First steps in spatial R: reading, plotting, manipulating and combining vector and raster data.
abstract: An introduction to spatial data science in R using sf and terra. Covers reading shapefiles and rasters, coordinate reference systems, basic spatial operations, and plotting spatial objects.

title: Rasters in Different Projections
desc: Coordinate reference systems in practice: bathymetry rasters reprojected and mapped alongside shapefiles.
abstract: A deep dive into coordinate reference systems and map projections in R. Reads bathymetry rasters and shapefiles, reprojects them, and builds complex multi-layer maps.

title: Mapping with Satellite Imagery
desc: Landsat-based NDVI, spectral resolution and RGB composite mapping in R.
abstract: Working with satellite imagery in R: loading multi-band Landsat rasters, computing NDVI and other spectral indices, producing RGB composites, and interpreting spectral resolution.
